scope: Read-only diagnosis of already frozen original-validation predictions. No new models or historical-label access. This is conditional development evidence, not independent validation.
routing_definition: Cu>1e-12 AND O>1e-12 first; otherwise Fe>1e-12 AND (P+As+S+Se+Te)>1e-12; otherwise other. Operational composition routes, not verified superconductor families.

agent_minus_G01.subgroup_contribution_note: Zero and positive contributions partition the overall MAE difference. High-Tc is a subset of positive, so do not add it again.

conditional_bootstrap.scope: Conditional paired strict-group development bootstrap. Original validation was historically inspected and is not fresh independent evidence. Excludes model/search/training uncertainty.

interpretation.causal_limit: This explains where recorded error changes occurred; it does not identify a physical mechanism or prove route choice causes improvement on fresh data.
